title: Honest Scales
summary: Start: enter the system. The log opens Honest Scales and the helm marks Lamp Yard. Do: Close on Lamp Yard. Two range cutters orbit the yard and hail if you crowd the guns. The Scale Clerk weighs fuel and ammo in public. Finish: come inside Lamp Yard's shell. The Compact writes standing and a rumor. The grain delivery is a separate contract. Fail: there is no timer. Leave and the job stays open until you close.
